text.en: 2 + 3 × 4 means 2, and three groups of 4. The groups must be counted before anything joins them.

learned.en: $n^2$ is the area of a square of side n; $\sqrt{n}$ is the side.

then.en: Side 12, so $\sqrt{144} = 12$. A root undoes a square.

text.en: Going from one square to the next adds a gold L shape around two edges.

then.en: 16 + 9 = 25. The L has 9 squares: 4, 4 and the corner.

text.en: A square is side × side, so each prime appears an even number of times. Is 468 a perfect square?

do.en: Tap matching primes to pair them.

then.en: 13 has no partner, so 468 is not a perfect square. Multiply by 13 and it is.
